title: The Works: tier 8, The launch
lines: Tier 8 is open. A charger charges a cell to 3 bars. Every 20 seconds, every charged cell loses a bar.
A launch pad launches when it holds its rocket's parts and 1,000 charged cells at once. Your first launch puts a light in the town's sky.

more.head: New
points: A cell with no bars left is a plain cell again. The launch pad does not take it.
A test rocket needs 100 charged cells at once.
Cells, hull sections and rocket fuel.
